name: Crossbowman
summary: A crossbow specialist who trades armor and weapon training for readied-shot precision, fast sniping, and penetrating bolts.

features.name: Deadshot
features.summary: When you attack with a crossbow as a readied action, add half your Dexterity bonus (minimum +1) to damage.

features.name: Improved Deadshot
features.summary: A target of your readied crossbow attack is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.

features.name: Greater Deadshot
features.summary: When you attack with a crossbow as a readied action, add your full Dexterity bonus (minimum +1) to damage.

features.name: Pinpoint Targeting
features.summary: Gain Pinpoint Targeting as a bonus feat.

features.name: Crossbow Expert +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on attack and damage rolls with crossbows.

features.name: Quick Sniper
features.summary: Add half your fighter level to Stealth checks when sniping. When hit by a ranged attack, you can immediately shoot a loaded crossbow at the attacker.

features.name: Crossbow Expert +2
features.summary: Gain +2 on attack and damage rolls with crossbows.

features.name: Safe Shot
features.summary: Crossbow ranged attacks no longer provoke attacks of opportunity.

features.name: Crossbow Expert +3
features.summary: Gain +3 on attack and damage rolls with crossbows.

features.name: Meteor Shot
features.summary: As a standard action, make a crossbow attack at -4; on a hit, also attempt a bull rush or trip using the attack roll as the combat maneuver check.

features.name: Crossbow Expert +4
features.summary: Gain +4 on attack and damage rolls with crossbows.

features.name: Penetrating Shot
features.summary: A confirmed crossbow critical can pierce the target and attack additional creatures in line, with a cumulative -4 penalty per secondary attack.

featureOverrides.summary: Master one type of crossbow and improve its critical performance.
